title: Half-Bridge ZVS Leg
description: Half-bridge MOSFET leg with an L-R load illustrating zero-voltage switching and the role of dead-time.

source.author: J. Marcos Alonso
source.video: Understanding Zero Voltage Switching in Half-Bridge Converters
source.permission: Adapted and redistributed with the author's permission.
source.note: half_bridge_zvs.qsch is Alonso's schematic; half_bridge_zvs.cir is the self-contained netlist produced by QSpice/QUX with his behavioral component library embedded.

workflows.title: Half-Bridge ZVS Leg -- materialize recipe
workflows.summary: Copy the bundled files into the workspace and simulate the self-contained .cir (Track B).

topology_block_note: The power stage matches the half_bridge_converter topology block; this recipe adds a ZVS leg (dead-time drive plus resonant transition) on top of it.
